items.title: Morgan Stanley Gains 45.1% in a Year: Should You Buy MS Stock Now?
items.summary: MS outpaces peers with a 45.1% share price gain, but trading cyclicality, rising expenses and a premium valuation could limit further upside.

items.title: JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley Fight Suits Over Role in Buyout Deals
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Morgan Stanley are among banks shareholders are suing over their roles on multibillion-dollar buyout deals after a recent corporate-law overhaul failed to protect financial advisers from potential liability.

items.title: Morgan Stanley warns bond yields could rise in post-WWII-style era
items.summary: The investment bank says market dynamics have shifted away from the disinflationary boom that ran from 1982 to 2020

items.title: Morgan Stanley’s Bobby Singh: Why We Are Exploring an International Wealth Push
items.summary: The largest offshore wealth provider in the U.S. would like to serve clients on their own turf. Bobby Singh is leading the effort.

items.title: Morgan Stanley’s Wilson Sees Higher Oil as Key Risk for Equities
items.summary: A renewed spike in oil prices is the biggest risk facing US stocks, according to Morgan Stanley’s Michael Wilson, who recommended using energy shares to hedge portfolios.

items.title: Morgan Stanley starts Rio Tinto ADR coverage at underweight, sees 14% downside
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley initiated coverage of Rio Tinto’s (NYSE:RIO) American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) at Underweight with a $90 price target, set using the prevailing exchange rate, saying its fundamental views on the ADR are fully aligned with those on the underlying stock. The price target implies more than 14% downside from the last closing price.

items.title: Alibaba Seeks $10 Billion From Share Sale for AI Expansion
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is seeking to raise about HK$80 billion ($10.2 billion) from a share sale, its latest move to compete for global leadership in artificial intelligence.

items.title: Can Morgan Stanley (MS) Stay A Bargain Or Is It Fully Priced?
items.summary: Morgan Stanley stock has returned 182.2% over the past three years and now trades around what valuation checks suggest is roughly fair, so the question for investors is whether the current price still offers an attractive payoff for new money. A 182.2% gain over three years puts pressure on buyers to judge whether much of Morgan Stanley's value story is already reflected in the share price.
